labor.review.rate.label: Labor rate — review / redaction ($/hr)
labor.review.rate.notes: No $/hr rate. Review/redaction time — including attorney review/redaction/segregation time — is chargeable at actual cost; attorney time spent determining whether the exemptions APPLY is expressly NOT chargeable (192.324(4)(b), OR-0021). City sets the operative rate within actual cost.

labor.programming.rate.label: Labor rate — programming / data extraction ($/hr)
labor.programming.rate.notes: Programming/data extraction sits squarely in 'summarizing, compiling or tailoring the public records, either in organization or media'. No fixed rate; city sets the operative $/hr within actual cost.

waiver.label: Fee waiver: grounds, mandatory vs discretionary, purpose statement, written denial, appeal
waiver.value: discretionary public-interest waiver/reduction; no purpose statement required; denial reviewable by petition to AG/DA/court; reviewing body may also order waiver for untimely response
waiver.notes: Shape: (1) grounds = public interest / primarily benefits the general public (192.324(5), OR-0023) — DISCRETIONARY ('may'), never mandatory; (2) no statutory purpose-statement or written-denial-form requirement; (3) appeal = petition to AG or DA 'in the same manner as' a records-denial petition, …

waiver.forfeiture.label: Late response forfeits the fee
waiver.forfeiture.value: no automatic forfeiture; AG/DA/court MAY order a fee waiver or reduction on petition if the body responded with undue delay or failed to respond as prescribed
waiver.forfeiture.notes: Oregon has a late-response fee consequence, but it is remedial and discretionary, not self-executing: forfeiture happens only if a requester petitions under 192.407 and the AG/DA/court orders the waiver (the same order may also carry a $200 penalty for undue delay, 192.407(3)(b) — penalty amount …

repeat.label: Repeat / aggregated requests (carry-forward, aggregation threshold)
repeat.notes: Coverage: full ORS 192.311–192.478 opened — no repeat-request carry-forward, prior-unpaid-balance prepayment, or multi-request aggregation provision (contrast SC's 6-month re-request bar or TX aggregation). Each request stands alone; the only closure-and-return path is the 60-day nonpayment close…

fee.labor_charge.summary: A public body may include in the fee the cost of attorney time spent reviewing, redacting, or segregating records into exempt and nonexempt, but may NOT include attorney time spent determining the application of ORS 192.311 to 192.478.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: A public body may establish fees reasonably calculated to reimburse it for its actual cost of making public records available, including costs for summarizing, compiling or tailoring the records in organization or media to meet the request.

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: 'Custodian' means the person described in ORS 7.110 for court records, or a public body mandated (directly or indirectly) to create, maintain, care for or control a public record; a public body that is not the custodian and lacks control is not required to search for/produce a record.

intake.procedures_publication.summary: A public body shall make available to the public a written procedure for making public records requests that names one or more individuals (with addresses) to whom requests may be sent and states the amounts and manner of calculating fees.
